Name: GameSpeed
Author: RandomComputerUser
Description:
[youtube]zPgeBqmD2yU[/youtube]

This mod allows the user to change the speed of the game. Instead of merely changing the speed of the in-game clock, this mod changes the speed of everything in the game. High game speed values may cause lag.

IT IS RECOMMENDED TO BACK UP YOUR SAVE FILE BEFORE USING THIS MOD

Known issues:
[list]
[*]User interaction is awkward
[*]Notifications for game speed appear for different durations depending on the game speed
[/list]
Controls:
[list]
[*]PageUp to increase Speed
[*]PageDown to decrease Speed
[*]F1 to set Speed to 0.25x
[*]F2 to set Speed to 0.5x
[*]F3 to set Speed to 0.75x
[*]F5 to set Speed to 1x
[*]F6 to set Speed to 2x
[*]F7 to set Speed to 3x
[*]F8 to set Speed to 4x
[*]F9 to set Speed to 10x
[*]F10 to set Speed to 30x
[/list]You may also use the console command "game speed <multiplier>" to manually set the game speed.

Manifest.Name: GameSpeed
Manifest.Description: Allows the user to change the speed of the game. This does not change the speed of the in-game clock, but instead the real-time speed of the game.
